name: pizarra-udec
description: Pizarra colaborativa en tiempo real para eventos de la Universidad de Concepción

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @pizarra/server" "npm run dev -w @pizarra/client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @pizarra/client && npm run build -w @pizarra/server
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p shared --noEmit && tsc -p server --noEmit && tsc -p client --noEmit
scripts.dev:lan: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,magenta "npm run dev:lan -w @pizarra/server" "npm run dev:lan -w @pizarra/client"
